title: Incoming: Air Strikes and Air Defense
description: Modern air strikes on a real scale: Shahed drones, Lancets, cruise missiles, Grad rocket salvos, a B-2 bomber and a nuclear ICBM, aimed with one designator. A surface-to-air missile system shoots down drones, cruise missiles and bombers.
